conceptProposals.label: Nurse
conceptProposals.definition: A nursing professional; not the verb breastfeed or a complete request.

conceptProposals.label: Medicine
conceptProposals.definition: Medication; not all drugs, treatment, or medical advice.

conceptProposals.label: Headache
conceptProposals.definition: Pain in the head; exact location and severity require review.

conceptProposals.label: Health
conceptProposals.definition: Physical health or wellbeing; not a diagnosis or promise of care.

conceptProposals.label: Blood
conceptProposals.definition: Blood as a body fluid; not family ancestry or metaphorical meanings.

conceptProposals.label: Body
conceptProposals.definition: A human physical body; not an organization or body of text.

conceptProposals.label: Breathe
conceptProposals.definition: Breathe or respire; intensity and clinical meanings are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Cough
conceptProposals.definition: Coughing as an action; not a diagnosis.

conceptProposals.label: Therapy
conceptProposals.definition: Therapeutic treatment; type and source variant require human review.

conceptProposals.label: Surgery
conceptProposals.definition: A surgical procedure; not an office or a guaranteed operation.

conceptProposals.label: Vomit
conceptProposals.definition: Expel stomach contents; nonmanual features need review.
exampleContexts: I feel like I may vomit.

conceptProposals.label: Rest
conceptProposals.definition: Rest or take a break; not the remainder of a quantity.

conceptProposals.label: Clean
conceptProposals.definition: Clean or remove dirt; not an unrelated metaphorical meaning.

conceptProposals.label: Dirty
conceptProposals.definition: Dirty or unclean; not obscene language or metaphorical behavior.

conceptProposals.label: Soap
conceptProposals.definition: Soap used for washing; not a soap opera.

conceptProposals.label: Shower
conceptProposals.definition: A shower for washing; not rain or a celebration.

conceptProposals.label: Bed
conceptProposals.definition: A bed for sleeping; not a garden bed or river bed.

conceptProposals.label: Bedroom
conceptProposals.definition: A room used for sleeping; not a reviewed compound assembled from separate clips.

conceptProposals.label: Kitchen
conceptProposals.definition: A room for preparing food.

conceptProposals.label: Chair
conceptProposals.definition: A chair for sitting; not chairing a committee.

conceptProposals.label: Door
conceptProposals.definition: A door opening into a space; not opportunity or a named product.

conceptProposals.label: Window
conceptProposals.definition: A window in a building; not a software window.

conceptProposals.label: Clothes
conceptProposals.definition: Clothing or garments; source lexical scope requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Shirt
conceptProposals.definition: A shirt garment; not all clothes.

conceptProposals.label: Shoes
conceptProposals.definition: Shoes or footwear; exact singular/plural realization requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Banana
conceptProposals.definition: A banana fruit.

conceptProposals.label: Cheese
conceptProposals.definition: Cheese as food; not a request to smile for a photograph.

conceptProposals.label: Egg
conceptProposals.definition: An egg as food; not a metaphorical egg.

conceptProposals.label: Fruit
conceptProposals.definition: Fruit as food; not metaphorical results.

conceptProposals.label: Orange
conceptProposals.definition: The orange fruit; color and other senses require clarification.

conceptProposals.label: Potato
conceptProposals.definition: A potato as food.

conceptProposals.label: Tomato
conceptProposals.definition: A tomato as food.

conceptProposals.label: Soup
conceptProposals.definition: Soup as food; not a generic meal request.

conceptProposals.label: Sandwich
conceptProposals.definition: A sandwich as food; not the verb squeeze between objects.

conceptProposals.label: Salt
conceptProposals.definition: Salt as a food seasoning; not the sea or a chemistry-specific claim.

conceptProposals.label: Cook
conceptProposals.definition: Prepare food by cooking; not a person who is a cook.

conceptProposals.label: Delicious
conceptProposals.definition: Food tasting pleasant; intensity and facial expression require review.

conceptProposals.label: Full
conceptProposals.definition: Satiated after eating; container capacity and filled spaces remain different senses.

conceptProposals.label: Restaurant
conceptProposals.definition: A restaurant; not an automatically translated request for a table.

conceptProposals.label: Husband
conceptProposals.definition: A husband or male spouse; relationship and regional variant require review.

conceptProposals.label: Wife
conceptProposals.definition: A wife or female spouse; relationship and regional variant require review.

conceptProposals.label: Uncle
conceptProposals.definition: An uncle as a family relationship; not a personal name.

conceptProposals.label: Cousin
conceptProposals.definition: A cousin as a family relationship; gendered variants require review.

conceptProposals.label: Nephew
conceptProposals.definition: A nephew as a family relationship.

conceptProposals.label: Niece
conceptProposals.definition: A niece as a family relationship.

conceptProposals.label: Grandmother
conceptProposals.definition: A grandmother or female grandparent; exact family variant requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Grandfather
conceptProposals.definition: A grandfather or male grandparent; exact family variant requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Parents
conceptProposals.definition: Parents as a family relationship; number and family composition require review.

conceptProposals.label: Person
conceptProposals.definition: A human person; not the grammatical person of a verb.

conceptProposals.label: Adult
conceptProposals.definition: A grown person; not an unrelated media classification.

conceptProposals.label: Interpreter
conceptProposals.definition: A person interpreting between languages; not a software interpreter.

conceptProposals.label: Translate
conceptProposals.definition: Translate between languages; not movement or an automatic sentence translation promise.

conceptProposals.label: Talk
conceptProposals.definition: Talk or converse; exact modality, direction and discourse role require review.

conceptProposals.label: Show
conceptProposals.definition: Show something to another person; not a performance or television show.

conceptProposals.label: Sentence
conceptProposals.definition: A linguistic sentence; not a criminal punishment.

conceptProposals.label: Word
conceptProposals.definition: A word in a language; not a promise or named software product.

conceptProposals.label: Example
conceptProposals.definition: An illustrative example; not automatically a complete explanatory phrase.

conceptProposals.label: Class
conceptProposals.definition: An instructional class; not social class, quality, or programming.

conceptProposals.label: Lesson
conceptProposals.definition: A unit of teaching; not a punitive metaphor.

conceptProposals.label: Homework
conceptProposals.definition: Schoolwork assigned to do outside class.

conceptProposals.label: Library
conceptProposals.definition: A library for reading and borrowing; not a software library.

conceptProposals.label: Computer
conceptProposals.definition: A computer device; not a named product.

conceptProposals.label: Paper
conceptProposals.definition: Paper material; not automatically a newspaper, essay or examination.

conceptProposals.label: Pencil
conceptProposals.definition: A pencil writing tool; not a scheduling verb.

conceptProposals.label: Test
conceptProposals.definition: A test or assessment; medical tests and experimentation need separate context review.

conceptProposals.label: Afternoon
conceptProposals.definition: The period after noon; not a full good-afternoon greeting.

conceptProposals.label: Hour
conceptProposals.definition: An hour of duration; number incorporation requires separate review.

conceptProposals.label: Minute
conceptProposals.definition: A minute of duration; smallness or meeting minutes are separate senses.

conceptProposals.label: Monday
conceptProposals.definition: Monday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Wednesday
conceptProposals.definition: Wednesday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Thursday
conceptProposals.definition: Thursday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Friday
conceptProposals.definition: Friday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Saturday
conceptProposals.definition: Saturday as a weekday; recurrence and tense are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Later
conceptProposals.definition: At a later time; not a full farewell phrase.

conceptProposals.label: Late
conceptProposals.definition: Later than expected; not deceased or recent.

conceptProposals.label: Angry
conceptProposals.definition: Feeling anger; intensity and nonmanual features require review.

conceptProposals.label: Scared
conceptProposals.definition: Feeling fear; source handshape and facial features require review.

conceptProposals.label: Worry
conceptProposals.definition: Worry or feel concern; not an unrelated reassurance sentence.

conceptProposals.label: Bored
conceptProposals.definition: Feeling bored; not drilling a hole.

conceptProposals.label: Lonely
conceptProposals.definition: Feeling lonely; being physically alone is not assumed equivalent.

conceptProposals.label: Comfortable
conceptProposals.definition: Feeling comfortable; confident or financially secure meanings are not inferred.

conceptProposals.label: Relax
conceptProposals.definition: Relax or release tension; exact realization and nonmanuals require review.

conceptProposals.label: Stress
conceptProposals.definition: Psychological stress; mechanical pressure and word emphasis are separate senses.

conceptProposals.label: Smile
conceptProposals.definition: A smile as an action; not grammatical nonmanuals for arbitrary ASL sentences.

conceptProposals.label: Cry
conceptProposals.definition: Cry with tears; not call out or shout.
exampleContexts: I cry when I am sad.

conceptProposals.label: Laugh
conceptProposals.definition: Laugh as an action; expression and source timing require review.

conceptProposals.label: Ready
conceptProposals.definition: Being prepared or ready; not money or a complete question.

conceptProposals.label: Easy
conceptProposals.definition: Low difficulty; not a command to slow down.

conceptProposals.label: Hard
conceptProposals.definition: High difficulty; solid texture and physical force are separate senses.

conceptProposals.label: Different
conceptProposals.definition: Different or not the same; source variant and comparison scope require review.

conceptProposals.label: Old
conceptProposals.definition: Old in age; person versus object realization requires review.

conceptProposals.label: Young
conceptProposals.definition: Young in age; not a proper name.
